title: Boundless Database Generation Engine — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. PROPOSED CAPABILITY TARGET. This record describes a proposed future-grade capability target from the source paste. It is a specification of what such a tool would do, NOT a claim that it has been implemented, tested, or proven. Some entries build on existing research; others would require major scientific breakthroughs, new hardware, or extensive engineering. Generates new database schemas, record templates, and ingestion pipelines from defined knowledge requirements. A proposed engine that builds databases the way factories build products: from defined knowledge requirements it generates database schemas, record templates, and ingestion pipelines — then validates the result against the requirements before anything goes live. It is the tool that could build the rest of the database network, which is why it belongs in the apex tier.
